member.name: M:Tavstal.MesterMC.Api.Services.Authentication.AuthenticationHandlerBase.HandleUserAsync(Tavstal.MesterMC.Api.Models.Database.User.CustomUser)
member.summary: Verifies user validity, manages lockout status, and creates an authentication ticket.

remarks.para:
This method performs the following checks in order:
1. Validates user exists (returns fail if null).
2. Checks if user is locked out and lockout period is still active (returns fail if so).
3. Clears expired lockout status if lockout period has elapsed.
4. Creates standard claims (Name, NameIdentifier, Email).
5. Generates and returns a successful authentication ticket.
Lockout expiration is automatically cleared by updating the user in the database, allowing the user to authenticate again on their next attempt after the lockout period expires.

member.param: The user object to process. If null, authentication fails.
member.returns: An AuthenticateResult indicating success with a valid ticket and claims, or failure with an appropriate error message.
